technical_summary: POC highlights and technical constraints: - Workload: reranking + light generation for personalization under 100 token responses. Baseline qps target 800-1,200 sustained; campaign bursts up to 9,000 qps for short windows (minutes-hours). - Latency targets: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 150ms (strict). - POC observed: sustained baseline handled by Dedicated config; under 10x bursts we saw queue length growth and p99 spikes to 300-700ms depending on model variant and batch settings. - Root causes: request burst exceeds pre-warmed capacity; autoscaler reaction time (scale-up cool-down) allowed queue accumulation; batching introduced tail amplification for short requests. - Mitigations explored: pre-warmed burst pools (reserved hot slots), priority queues for control traffic, token-bucket rate shaping at ingress, predictive scaling based on campaign signals, model quantization to increase per-GPU throughput. - Redwood constraints: hosted API cannot guarantee zero-queue SLA at the needed ARR level; Dedicated + private recommended but customer balked at cost and procurement timeline. - Current technical fit: possible with Dedicated+Private with architectural changes and budget commitment; otherwise high risk of SLA misses during marketing peaks.
